meaning: Selected wheel slot 0..3 (wraps both ways); every read is movsx. name: state
meaning: 0 freeze the Wolf and start the intro anim, 1 wait for it, 2 idle/done, 3 (re)arm, 4 interactive spin, 5 confirmed — unfreeze, set SCN_OF_NEVER_UPDATE, then either exit the level or open the memory-card UI. Jump table 0x4e9be0.

name: snapping
meaning: Set to 1 whenever the player steps the wheel; while set the wheel integrates angVel toward targetAngle and clears itself (plus angVel = 0, angle snapped to index*PI/2) on reaching or overshooting it.

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Non-zero once the Wolf has accepted SCN_MSG_UI_FREEZE (0x0E); on confirm the wheel sends 0x0F and clears it. Same idiom as the existing CamShot.wolfFrozen row.

name: exitLevelOnConfirm
meaning: Branch selector on confirm: non-zero sets g_levelExitFlags bit 1 and calls Fade_StartLevelExit(0x1000); zero sends MSG_USE to the MCardManager (class 0x62) so the save UI opens. name: pad069
meaning: Never referenced; alignment between the s8 at 0x68 and the u16 at 0x6a.

name: unk6a
meaning: Zeroed by Scene_Wheel_Reset at 0x4e9ddf and never read or written anywhere else in the class (exactly one reference).

name: idleMs
meaning: Milliseconds (g_dtRawMs) since the last wheel step; reset on every step and by Reset. Accumulated every Update but never compared against anything — dead state as built.

name: pad06e
meaning: Never referenced; alignment between the u16 at 0x6c and the float at 0x70.

name: angVel
meaning: Angular velocity in rad/s, recomputed each frame as (targetAngle - currentAngle) * 2 (fadd st,st) and clamped to +-7*PI/4 (5.497787 at 0x576a88). Integrated as angle += g_dtMs * angVel / 1000.

name: unk074
meaning: A real 4-byte slot between the two floats that NOTHING in 0x4e9480-0x4e9e6d references (per the offset census). Both neighbours are 4-aligned, so it is not alignment. It must be carried explicitly or the 0x7c size assert will not reproduce.

name: targetAngle
meaning: Target wheel angle = index * PI/2 (1.5707964 at 0x576a8c); stepped by +-PI/2 per press and re-derived from index whenever the angle is wrapped into [0, 2*PI).
